newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket-Australia name Super Eights squad.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Australia name Super Eights squad.

text.p: Tasmania batsman Michael Di Venuto will captain Australia in the Super Eights tournament in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, in August, the Australian Cricket Board has announced.

The team is: Michael di Venuto (captain, Tasmania), Ryan Campbell (Western Australia), Jamie Cox (Tasmania), Adam Dale (Queensland), Ian Harvey (Victoria), Damien Martyn (Western Australia), David Saker (Victoria), Andrew Symonds (Queensland), Brad Young (South Australia).
